verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK covering conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management, with dedicated SDK doc pages and a companion CLI. Only one language is evidenced, and no public OpenAPI spec was found for generating clients in other languages. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/JS), a published OpenAPI spec for client generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
